g.text: PbSe core method — SI reported feed
Heating / feed cue; dose order and hardware are source-qualified
Inputs: Dried lead precursor mixture; SI 1 M Se injection mixture: TOP-Se and TBP
SI says quickly; no numerical injection rate. The main Methods report injection of 4 mL 2 M
TOP-Se; SI p.1 instead prepares 2 mL 2 M TOP-Se plus 2 mL TBP and calls the final feed 1 M Se.
These are conflicting descriptions of the source core method, not independently established
experimental batches. Neither is silently selected or corrected.
Generic conceptual vessel; source does not specify vessel dimensions, neck count, liquid level
